notes: Historical scripts, numeric results, candidates and provider usage retain original content unless a transformation is explicitly recorded.
Plain final-XX.txt files have a terminal newline added. audit/exact-final-text.json preserves original text and original SHA-256 byte-for-byte through JSON UTF-8 decoding.
An originally empty typecheck log is represented by one newline; the verification JSON records the historical outcome.
usage.jsonl and root-commands.json are explicit projections of original usage and execution events, not unmodified raw telemetry.
Raw OTLP, account identifiers, authentication files, runtime homes and CA private keys are excluded.
Historical absolute machine paths remain in archived scripts; use the portable runner for a new machine.
Dataset-v2 was regenerated using the archived fixture generator and checked byte-for-byte against all 44 historical files.
